Title: Ready Player Two (Ready Player One, #2)
Author: Ernest Cline
My Review: It is almost like a different person wrote the second installment of this series. Where the first book was an homage to 80s pop culture and a great from-zero-to-hero story, the second book is some sort of woke ripoff.   The writer is trying so hard to give some deeper meaning to his writing and check all the "inclusion" boxes, the story itself ends up taking a backseat. You're already half-way through of the book before the adventure you are hoping for actually begins and it is rushed through and very anticlimatic. I actually regret reading this book, as it also affects the fond memories I have of the first book.
